cc:Work.dc:description: Same regulated ideal-air burst. Absolute tank pressure falls from 30 to 3 MPa, tank/plenum temperature from 300 to 155.38 K, mass flow rises from 18.91 to 26.27 kg/s. Constant-pressure converging nozzle thrust remains 10 kN because momentum and pressure thrust are temperature independent under these assumptions. Real-gas properties and heat transfer are omitted.
